title: Does ABC's pre-layout delay and area view of 40 MAC engines survive placement and timing repair on SKY130?
summary: The eda loops score designs with Yosys and ABC only. Here the 40 MAC-engine designs (1–8 lanes, 4–8 bits) are mapped at two shared targets (5 and 8 ns) and then placed with OpenROAD (the pip install openroad wheel: floorplan, placement, placement-based parasitics, repair_timing; SKY130 HD tt 25 °C). ABC area still ranks repaired area (Spearman 0.997–0.999). ABC delay ranks placed delay at 0.61–0.80, and wires add a median 36% to the period (up to 1.99×; worst for 8-lane arrays). At 5 ns none of the 15 designs ABC calls feasible meets timing after placement; at 8 ns, 39 are feasible in ABC, 1 after placement and 27 after repair for 3.5% median area. Where a front exists it is unchanged (p8, p4, p2, p1 at 4 bits) and p4w4 stays best by area × latency. Limits: no routing or clock tree (the wheel's Tcl floorplan and track commands segfault, so placement parasitics are used), ideal clock, repair stops at timing met so repaired periods are capped, one family, one recipe, one utilisation; not sign-off.
lede: the 40 MAC engines placed with the pip OpenROAD wheel: ABC area still ranks placed area (Spearman 0.997+), ABC delay only 0.61 to 0.80, wires add a median 36% to the period, and no design ABC calls feasible at 5 ns meets it after placement.
